description:
Get the details of all role management policy assignments made in PIM for Microsoft Entra roles and PIM for Groups.

TIP: Lists PIM role management policy assignments. Links policies to specific roles. Each has policyId, scopeId, scopeType, and roleDefinitionId. Use $expand=policy($expand=rules) to include the full policy details.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-role-management-policy-assignments
